reasons.plausibility: Adding Al or Cr to form a protective oxide is well-established in high-temperature alloys, though there is some concern over possible phase changes affecting mechanical performance, hence it remains largely sound but with minor uncertainties.
reasons.testability: It can be tested by straightforward isothermal oxidation and mechanical evaluations comparing baseline and modified alloys, which would definitively validate or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: This approach addresses a key limitation by providing a clear, standard intervention to enhance oxidation resistance without unduly compromising mechanical properties, making it practically valuable.
